nodes.label: Caddy reverse proxy
nodes.rationale: Terminates TLS, HTTP/3, security headers, compression; proxies to app on 127.0.0.1:3000; sets X-Real-IP for rate limiting and X-Forwarded-* for public origin

nodes.label: DB schema & drizzle-kit migrations
nodes.rationale: schema.ts in apps/web/src/lib/server/db; migrations bundled and run at startup

nodes.label: SQLite via node:sqlite
nodes.rationale: Built-in node:sqlite avoids native addon ABI issues between build/runtime Node and amd64/arm64

nodes.label: s6-overlay supervision
nodes.rationale: Starts init-config, app, caddy; container exits on permanent failure so Docker restarts it

nodes.label: snapshot table
nodes.rationale: Normalized values every fetch; raw responses only when changed since previous fetch

nodes.label: Wolfi base image
nodes.rationale: Very small with fast security updates

nodes.label: Bilingual wiki updated in same PR
nodes.norm_label: bilingual wiki updated in same pr

nodes.label: Better Auth
nodes.rationale: Email+password, passkey, GitHub, Google, OIDC; Drizzle adapter; signup rule enforced in DB hook for every method

nodes.label: APP_URL
nodes.rationale: Public URL; base for OAuth callbacks and passkeys

nodes.label: AUTH_ALLOW_SIGNUP / first-account-admin rule
nodes.rationale: First account becomes admin via /setup; further accounts (incl. first OAuth/SSO sign-in) refused unless enabled

nodes.label: AUTH_SECRET
nodes.rationale: Signs sessions; generated into /data/auth-secret if empty; changing signs everyone out

nodes.label: DATA_DIR / /data volume
nodes.rationale: Holds ev-dashboard.db, auth-secret, encryption-key, Caddy certs; back up incl. key files

nodes.label: RETENTION_DAYS
nodes.rationale: Default 365; 0 = forever; daily cleanup

nodes.label: connect-query provider module
nodes.rationale: Brand-neutral name for the manufacturer API module

nodes.label: Background poller
nodes.rationale: In-process poller fetching snapshots per connection

nodes.label: VehicleProvider interface
nodes.rationale: authorizeUrl, exchangeCode, refresh, listVehicles, fetchSnapshot; lets new providers be added without touching the core

nodes.label: ENCRYPTION_KEY
nodes.rationale: AES-256-GCM encryption of vehicle API credentials and tokens; changing makes stored credentials unreadable

nodes.label: POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS
nodes.rationale: Default 300, min 60; polling too often can lock the vehicle account

nodes.label: Read-only polling API
nodes.rationale: No commands; polling not push

nodes.label: Vehicle connection (one per consent)
nodes.rationale: Each consent is its own connection with its own token; endpoints carry no vehicle ID

nodes.label: Brand neutral principle
nodes.rationale: No manufacturer names, logos or design imitation

nodes.label: Configuration exclusively via environment variables
nodes.rationale: No config files to edit; every variable documented in .env.example and the configuration wiki pages; declared in apps/web/src/env.ts

nodes.label: PR-only workflow (never push to main)
nodes.rationale: main is protected; all changes reviewed and merged only after green checks

nodes.label: Pin GitHub Actions by full commit SHA
nodes.norm_label: pin github actions by full commit sha
nodes.rationale: Supply-chain hardening: immutable action references, kept current via Renovate

nodes.label: Vendor neutrality (no vehicle manufacturer names)
nodes.rationale: Provider modules use neutral identifiers; avoids manufacturer names/logos in product, UI, README and wiki

nodes.label: Pipeline hardening
nodes.rationale: SHA-pinned actions, minimal permissions, no pull_request_target, no secrets in PR runs

nodes.label: release.yml publishing pipeline
nodes.rationale: Multi-arch build, Trivy scan, keyless Cosign signature, provenance attestation, SPDX SBOM

nodes.label: UI module cards
nodes.rationale: Self-contained cards (map, range, charging, trips) with same structure, can be shown/hidden

nodes.label: Normalized telemetry values (metric)
nodes.rationale: Tolerant mapping guessing unknown fields from typical names since response formats are only partly known

nodes.label: Calm cockpit guiding idea
nodes.rationale: Answer 'where is my car, how far can I go' in under two seconds; everything else one level deeper

nodes.label: Honest data principle
nodes.rationale: Stale, estimated, missing values are marked

nodes.label: Precision without noise
nodes.rationale: Values always with time of last update

nodes.label: Visibly modular cards
nodes.rationale: Each module is a card with title, main value, context, timestamp

nodes.label: Cosign signature verification
nodes.rationale: Only images signed by this repo's release pipeline ever run

nodes.label: ev-dashboard-deploy forced command
nodes.rationale: Accepts exactly one digest then calls ev-dashboard-update

nodes.label: ev-dashboard-update script
nodes.rationale: Pulls image, verifies Cosign signature, pins digest in compose.override.yaml, waits 120s for healthy

nodes.label: GitHub production environment
nodes.rationale: DEPLOY_SSH_KEY, DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS secrets; restricted to main

nodes.label: SSH deploy from GitHub Actions (push)
nodes.rationale: Restricted forced-command key can only pass a digest; docker group is effectively root so a plain key would be a master key

nodes.label: systemd update timer (pull)
nodes.rationale: Every 5 min, deploys latest release; no credentials in GitHub
